stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “At West Junior High, this subject rings at 12:00.”?
options: The cafeteria let students vote for one new lunch menu item.
Some students looked at it curiously, but no one said anything.
Some students said it was the quietest lunch start ever.
Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.
